title: Spring Community Cleanup
subject: Annual community cleanup event scheduled. All members are encouraged to participate in keeping our community beautiful.
content:
Join us for our annual Spring Community Cleanup! We'll be gathering at the community centre at 9:00 AM on Saturday.

Supplies will be provided including gloves, bags, and refreshments. Lunch will be served at noon.

Let's work together to keep Tataskweyak beautiful for everyone.

title: Chief & Council Meeting Summary – April 2026
subject: Summary of the latest Chief & Council session covering infrastructure updates, housing, and community programs.
content:
The Chief & Council met on April 10, 2026 to discuss the following items:

  • Infrastructure improvements on main roads
  • New housing project updates
  • Summer youth employment program planning
  • Water treatment facility maintenance schedule

A full report will be available at the band office.

title: Community Office Hours Update
subject: Updated office hours for the community administration building effective immediately.
content:
Please note the updated hours for the community administration office:

Monday to Friday: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed

For after-hours emergencies, please call the main line.

title: Youth Basketball Tournament
subject: Calling all youth! Sign up for the upcoming basketball tournament at the recreation centre.

title: Water Advisory Lifted
subject: The boil water advisory has been lifted. Tap water is safe to drink as of April 5, 2026.
content:
We are pleased to announce that the boil water advisory has been officially lifted following successful testing results.

Tap water is now safe for consumption. Thank you for your patience during this time.

title: Summer Employment Program – Now Accepting Applications
subject: Youth and young adults are invited to apply for summer positions across various community departments.
content:
Tataskweyak Cree Nation is now accepting applications for the 2026 Summer Employment Program.

Eligibility: TCN members aged 16–30

Positions available in:

  • Parks & Recreation
  • Community Maintenance
  • Administration Support
  • Youth Programs

Applications are available at the band office or online through Achimowin. Deadline: May 1, 2026.
